sources.title: Mistral raises 1.7B€ to accelerate technological progress with AI

event.title: Mistral AI Series C
event.summary: Mistral AI raised €1.7 billion in a Series C round led by ASML, at an €11.7 billion post-money valuation.

amounts.label: Series C equity
amounts.quote: Mistral raises 1.7B€ to accelerate technological progress with AI

amounts.label: Post-money valuation
amounts.quote: We are announcing a Series C funding round of 1.7B€ at a 11.7B€ post-money valuation.

facts.label: Lead investor
facts.text: ASML, a semiconductor equipment maker, led the round.
facts.quote: The Series C funding round is led by leading semiconductor equipment manufacturer, ASML Holding NV (ASML).

facts.label: Strategic partnership
facts.text: ASML also entered a strategic partnership with Mistral AI.
facts.quote: ASML is proud to enter a strategic partnership with Mistral AI, and to be lead investor in this funding round.

facts.label: Other named investors
facts.text: Existing investors DST Global, Andreessen Horowitz, Bpifrance, General Catalyst, Index Ventures, Lightspeed and NVIDIA took part.
facts.quote: It includes participation from existing investors: DST Global, Andreessen Horowitz, Bpifrance, General Catalyst, Index Ventures, Lightspeed and NVIDIA.
